verdict.rationale: Rootly's Workflows engine runs structured actions automatically from trigger events and run conditions, with 152 action types including AI actions. It automates response steps such as creating channels, updating stakeholders, filing tickets and starting retros, and AI features like Meeting Scribe and AI SRE work on incidents and alerts without manual prompting. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of workflows running unattended, and details on whether AI SRE investigations trigger on their own in the background rather than on request.
